question: Among the male patients who have a normal level of white blood cells, how many of them have an abnormal fibrinogen level?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM PatientInfo AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2
  ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9
  AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM PatientInfo AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 4 AND 10
  AND T2.FG > 400
